description: This PHP source file defines a function 'vtws_revise' that handles updating (revising) an entity record through a web service interface in vtiger CRM. It involves permission checks, reference validation, and invoking methods on handler objects for the revision process.

classes.name: VtigerWebserviceObject
classes.description: A class representing web service objects within vtiger CRM, used for dynamic handling of different entity types.

classes.name: EntityMeta
classes.description: A class providing metadata and permission information related to CRM entities.

methods.name: vtws_revise
methods.description: Performs validation and revision (update) of a CRM entity via web service, with permission checks and reference validation.
